meta.name: V3 Repeatability Sanity Validation
meta.objective: Identify any remaining patches after the validated full V3 completion, define the scaffolding needed for repeatable sanity reruns, and decide whether to relaunch a new sanity run immediately.

compile.baseHint: Use the just-completed full V3 pass as the baseline, prefer no new patch unless a concrete blocker emerges, and only relaunch after an explicit repeatability gate says the runtime is still clean enough to trust another run.
taskSignals: The latest full 18-experiment V3 pass completed scientifically valid with zero run errors.
The score-stage batch-attempt timeout is now validated live, but repeatability still needs another sanity rerun to prove the pass is not one-off luck.
The user explicitly wants deep-workflow scaffolding around identifying any remaining patches, defining the rerun scaffolding, and then trying again.
notes: Patches are conditional, not assumed. If the repeatability audit finds no new blocker, the workflow should relaunch without code changes.

The sanity rerun does not need to wait for full terminal completion in this turn if it would take many hours; the gate can validate repeatability at launch integrity, direct-policy correctness, and first score-stage batch submission.

stopConditions: Abort relaunch if the patch audit finds a new concrete blocker that would invalidate another live pass.
Abort relaunch if reset cannot return the cohort to preflight_clean with healthy queues.

Treat the sanity rerun as validated for this turn once launch integrity is clean, 30-target stages stay direct-only, and at least one representative score_gen batch reaches submitted with no worker/process error.
